name: Mihaela Popescu
bio:
Mihaela's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a visit to a local rally race as a teenager. Captivated by the raw power and intricate engineering of the cars, she pursued a degree in materials science, focusing on composite materials. After graduation, she honed her skills in the aerospace industry before transitioning to motorsport. Her meticulous approach and deep understanding of material properties ensure that every component she works on meets the highest standards of performance and safety.

At Iron Lynx, Mihaela is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to troubleshoot complex issues quickly. She's passionate about mentoring junior technicians, sharing her knowledge and fostering a collaborative environment. Her colleagues appreciate her innovative ideas and willingness to explore new techniques to improve the performance and durability of the race cars. She brings a unique blend of practical experience and forward-thinking vision to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A woman of average height with a focused and intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her workbench when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while working on delicate composite repairs.
